description: Compare the economics of how a business charges today, by the hour or by the day, with fixed packages for the same work. Takes the cost base, the current rate and unit, the share of hours worked that reach an invoice, one to three packages with price and typical effort, and jobs per month. The current rate always comes from the user and is never assumed. Returns, at several efficiency gains (default 0, 15 and 30 percent less effort as delivery gets repeatable), revenue and profit per job and per month under each model, earnings per hour worked, revenue ceilings at full capacity, the package price that matches what each job collects today, and plain findings. Deterministic arithmetic with the method explained.

delivery_hours_per_month.description: Hours the whole team can put into client work in a month, not counting sales and admin. Used to measure capacity and cost, never shown to clients.

monthly_fixed_costs.description: Overhead every month regardless of work: rent, software, insurance, vehicles, accounting.

monthly_owner_pay.description: What the owner needs to take home each month. It is treated as a cost, so profit is what is left after the owner is paid.

monthly_staff_cost.description: Salaried team cost per month, including payroll taxes. Default 0.

planned_utilization_pct.description: Share of delivery hours expected to be filled in a normal month. Default 80.

variable_cost_per_hour.description: Cost that rises with each delivery hour, such as subcontractor or crew wages. Default 0.

billed_share_pct.description: Share of hours actually worked that end up on invoices, after write-downs and unbilled admin. Default 85.

direct_costs_passed_through.description: True when materials and other direct costs are charged to the client at cost today. Default true.

hours_per_day.description: Hours in a charged day, when unit is day. Default 8.

unit.description: Whether the current rate is charged per hour or per day.

efficiency_gains_pct.description: Effort reductions to compare, in percent. Default 0, 15, 30.

effort_hours.description: Typical delivery effort for the same job today.

share_pct.description: Share of jobs that would be this package. Give for all or none.

name: compare_models
title: Compare time-based billing with packages
